# fptcloud_backup_native_volume_restore_points (Data Source)

Lists the restore points of a volume, newest first. Restore points of a deleted volume backup job are listed too.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_backup_native_volume_restore_points" "data" {
  vpc_id    = var.vpc_id
  volume_id = var.pv_volume_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `volume_id` (String) ID of the volume.
- `vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `restore_points` (List of Object) Restore points, newest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--restore_points))

<a id="nestedatt--restore_points"></a>
### Nested Schema for `restore_points`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `is_available` (Boolean)
- `is_incremental` (Boolean)
- `size` (Number)
- `status` (String)
